items.title: What the Amex Travel-Airbnb Deal Means for Expedia
items.snippet: Skift Take: On paper, Airbnb's exclusive short-term rental partnership with Amex Travel didn't change anything for Expedia because it wasn't supplying vacation rentals to Amex Travel. But Expedia's Vrbo has begun supplying vacation rentals to other B2B partners, and now the Airbnb deal blocks that potential expansion. Two online travel rivals are now selling side by side on American Express Travel.

items.title: How Holiday Inn Paris — Gare de Lyon Bastille Unlocked an Extra €2K in Monthly Revenue
items.snippet: Holiday Inn Paris Gare de Lyon Bastille generates €2K monthly in upsell revenue and reclaims significant staff time after deploying Canary Technologies' full guest management suite.

items.title: IHG passes 1,000 open hotels in Europe, with more than 280 projects in development
items.snippet: IHG Hotels & Resorts has passed the milestone of 1,000 open hotels on the Old Continent. The group has added more than 210 properties there in three years and has more than 280 projects in development. Among the recent openings is the Ruby Lilou, the first hotel of the Ruby brand in France, in Marseille.

items.title: IHG Hotels & Resorts signs Holiday Inn Raipur
items.snippet: IHG® Hotels & Resorts , one of the world’s leading hospitality companies, has signed a management agreement with Entry Point Hotels & Resorts Private Limited to develop Holiday Inn Raipur in Naya Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

items.title: Black Rock Hotels & Resorts launches 241-key Udaipur Project
items.snippet: Black Rock Hotels & Resorts has unveiled an expansion pipeline of approximately 900 rooms, marking a significant new phase for the Rajasthan-based hospitality company as it moves beyond third-party hotel management into hotel ownership and enters new markets across North India. The company, which currently operates seven hotels with approximately 950 rooms, is targeting six additional hotel openings through 2027.

items.title: Is Trondheim the Nordics’ Coolest New Business Stop? Its Tastemakers Think So
items.snippet: From a floating sauna village to a ballroom restaurant, three local entrepreneurs reveal where to eat, unwind and make connections in Norway’s third city, and why its cooperative spirit makes it so rewarding to work in.

items.title: Westlife Foodworld delivers strongest growth momentum with double-digit same-store sales growth in Q2 FY27
items.snippet: The company delivered one of its strongest quarterly performances in recent years, with revenue from operations increasing 16 percent year-on-year to Rs 747 crore and same store sales growth (SSSG) accelerating to 10.1 percent, driven by double-digit guest count growth. Strong operating leverage and disciplined cost management supported continued profitability growth during the quarter.

items.title: Akasa Air strengthens its network as daily number of departures cross 200
items.snippet: Akasa Air, India’s fastest-growing airline, announced a significant scale-up of its network with new connections and increased frequencies across key routes underscoring Akasa Air’s continued focus on building a robust network and offering travellers greater convenience, connectivity, and choice.

items.title: Yatra partners with 4 banks to offer special discounts on Diwali bookings to eligible patrons
items.snippet: Yatra Online Limited (Yatra) has partnered with AU Small Finance Bank, HSBC, RBL Bank and YES BANK to make travelling home for Diwali more affordable and convenient for customers across the country. Through this partnership, eligible cardholders can avail of special offers on domestic and international flights, as well as domestic hotel bookings made through Yatra’s website and app.

items.title: Radisson Hotel Group opens Jungle Home Resort Tadoba near Kolara Gate in Maharashtra
items.snippet: Radisson Hotel Group has announced the opening of Jungle Home Resort Tadoba, a member of Radisson Individuals Retreats, near the Kolara Gate of Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve in Maharashtra. The opening marks the Group’s first resort within a forest reserve and strengthens its presence in India’s emerging wildlife and nature-led tourism destinations.
